-- ROUND ROBIN TABLE --

CREATE TABLE RR_table
(
    id INT,
    name VARCHAR(500),
    salary INT,
    position VARCHAR(500)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
);

INSERT INTO RR_table
VALUES 
    (5,'Kathy',5500,'Data Engineer')
    
SELECT * FROM RR_table
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- REPLICATE TABLE --

CREATE SCHEMA gold;

CREATE TABLE gold.dim_product
(
    dim_key_prod INT,
    prod_id INT,
    prod_name VARCHAR(800)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
)

INSERT INTO gold.dim_product
VALUES 
    (1001,10,'coke')
    
SELECT * FROM gold.dim_product
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HASH TABLE --

CREATE TABLE gold.facttable
(
    dim_key_prod INT,
    revenue INT,
    cost INT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(dim_key_prod)
);

INSERT INTO gold.facttable
VALUES 
    (1001,3000,50)
    
SELECT * FROM gold.facttable
